text.tspan: M0–M4 implemented • M5 visual interaction planned • Local-first, agent-first, model-first
Compare PR with base · validate lineage and bindings
map criteria to tests · require trusted evidence
Agents reason about code; VCV checks declared facts.
THREE DISTINCT RECORDS INTENT = approved IR / CODE = observed Git checkout / EVIDENCE = claims, tests & checks
Code-first changes also enter reconciliation. A merged PR already contains the validated .vcv revision; no post-merge rewrite.
SOURCE: github.com/TheBluemist1404/vibe-code-visualiser · README + ADR 0007/0008/0009 · visual UI is a future adapter
